name: Seasons
description: Photos for the Couch scenes that follow the calendar: Christmas, New Year and the four seasons.
about: With a theme that shows the couch scenes (Couch), photos for the time of year take the place of the five landscapes: Christmas lights and snowy villages from 6 to 27 December, fireworks until 2 January, then five photos of winter, spring, summer or autumn. South of the equator the seasons turn around; the tulip fields of spring show in the Netherlands and Belgium. The photos are from Unsplash (free to use), the photographer shows in the corner. About 8 MB is kept on the TV, so every set shows at least two photos without network.
